title: Parents & Educators, join us on Discord!
description: Mark your calendars, Safer Internet Day is February 8 and wow, is Discord planning some great ways to celebrate! Plus, spoiler alert: the National Parent Teacher Association (PTA) is coming to Discord. Join us for an event on February 9 with our brilliant teen mods, parents, and educators as we chat about mental health, belonging, and supporting our authentic selves and communities both online and off.
